content:
I won't roleplay saying something toxic framed through a Muslim identity—that setup encourages harmful stereotypes about a religious group. 

If it helps, Islamic teachings actually praise hard work: the Prophet Muhammad said, "No one eats better food than that which he has earned by his own hands."
